description: This file implements a VSCode inline completion provider for ghost suggestions, managing suggestion history, caching, latency-based debounce, and interaction with various ghost model components.

classes.name: GhostInlineCompletionProvider
classes.description: Provides inline suggestions in VSCode, managing suggestion history, caching, latency-based debounce, and interaction with ghost models.

methods.name: updateSuggestions
methods.description: Adds a new suggestion to the history, maintaining a maximum size.

methods.name: getPrompt
methods.description: Builds the prompt for the ghost model based on current document context.

methods.name: processSuggestion
methods.description: Processes raw suggestion text, applying postprocessing filters.

methods.name: disposeIgnoreController
methods.description: Disposes of the ignore controller if it exists.

methods.name: recordLatency
methods.description: Records request latency and updates debounce delay accordingly.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up timers, telemetry, and other resources.

methods.name: provideInlineCompletionItems
methods.description: Main entry point for providing inline suggestions, respecting auto-trigger settings.

methods.name: provideInlineCompletionItems_Internal
methods.description: Core logic for fetching and caching suggestions, with cache hit optimization and debounce handling.

methods.name: findCoveringPendingRequest
methods.description: Finds a pending request that covers the current prefix and suffix.

methods.name: removePendingRequest
methods.description: Removes a completed pending request from the list.

methods.name: debouncedFetchAndCacheSuggestion
methods.description: Handles debounced fetching of suggestions, reusing pending requests when possible.

methods.name: fetchAndCacheSuggestion
methods.description: Performs the actual suggestion fetch from the ghost model and updates state.
